name: Sant Jaume de Llierca (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a light blue wavy fess across the centre and two juxtaposed pales, black and orange, at the hoist side of the centre.
history: The flag was approved on 14 September 2005 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4479 of 29 September 2005; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with a light blue wavy fess of three and a half crests 2/9 of the height at the centre and two juxtaposed pales each 5/54 of the length.

features.role: wavy fess of three and a half crests, 2/9 of the height
two juxtaposed pales each 5/54 of the length
